# Ahmed Abu Qahf (som3aware)

> Full-stack engineer. Product-minded. Design-driven.

Portfolio of a full-stack engineer with 7+ years building web and mobile apps with React, React Native and Node.js. The site is a keyboard-driven terminal-style workspace; every section is also readable as one plain page at https://som3aware.pages.dev/?plain. Full text: https://som3aware.pages.dev/llms-full.txt

## work

- [Cypienta](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/cypienta) (2026–): Security data platform that condenses and contextualizes telemetry before it reaches SIEM, SOAR and AI tools.
- [Stayro](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/stayro) (2025–26): Guest and host rental apps for the Saudi marketplace.
- [Hivo](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/hivo) (2025–26): Rental app for the Saudi marketplace.
- [Reconciled](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/reconciled) (2024–25): Invoice reconciliation platform for staffing agencies.
- [Outlined AI](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/outlined-ai) (2023): Internal AI tool that turns audio and video into structured notes.
- [Ads analyzer](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/ads-analyzer) (2023): Turns feedback on image ads into creative briefs, built for Konstant Kreative.
- [Slack assistant](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/slack-bot) (2023): Slack assistant that answers questions across Google Drive, Gmail, Calendar, ClickUp and Fireflies.
- [Resume screening](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/resume-screening) (2023): Recruiters enter a job description and ask questions about candidates' resumes.
- [ECARD](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/ecard) (2021–23): Android app for the Egyptian Company for Agricultural and Rural Development.
- [Ramses Wi-Fi](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/ramses-wifi) (2021–23): The journey people go through to get online on Ramses Station's free Wi-Fi, with advertisers' ads.
- [ERP attendance](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/erp-attendance) (2021–23): APIs that pass valid fingerprint punches from ZKTeco scanners to Odoo's attendance module.
- [COVID-19 platform](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/covid-mobility) (2020–21): Platform for governments in Vodafone markets to see anonymised movement between cities and spot crowded areas.
- [HR system](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/hr-system) (2020–21): HR management system for HR staff and employees, covering HR services including benefits.
- [Component library](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/component-library) (2020–21): React Native component library built from Vodafone's brand guidelines.
- [Call-centre app](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/digital-twin) (2020–21): Lets call-centre managers monitor team performance and forecast metrics under different working conditions.
- [This portfolio](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/portfolio) (2026): This portfolio: a keyboard-driven, TUI-style workspace with a plain-page fallback.
- [Editor Setup](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/editor-setup) (2025): Curated VS Code font and theme pairings.
- [Sharp Studio](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/sharp-studio) (2024): Hackable image processing: convert, resize and compress.
- [Open Trivia](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/open-trivia) (2024): Multi-round trivia game on the Open Trivia API.
- [Covid Tracker](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/covid-tracker) (2023): App to track COVID patients behind a simple, authenticated interface.
- [Storefront API](https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/work/storefront-api) (2022): Node API for a store, with typed models and a relational database.
